g.text: Celebrity vs normal scenario, closed mode (labels: rank within the scenario, change vs normal)

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: The ranking reverses: Redis and Cassandra (fan-out on write) take the top two places under normal activity, but when the most-followed users are

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: also the most active, MongoDB leads and Cassandra falls to last.

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: c=8: normal Redis > Cassandra > MongoDB > Neo4j | celebrity MongoDB > Redis > Neo4j > Cassandra

text.style: font-size: 6.5px; font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e
